### Create `apps/api/test/imports-chunk.test.ts`

```ts
import { createHash, randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { existsSync, mkdirSync, mkdtempSync, readFileSync, rmSync, statSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import path from "node:path";
import pino from "pino";
import { afterAll, describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { IMPORT_RULES, type ImportSource, type ImportStatus } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { JobFile } from "@korbat/import-protocol";
import { ImportError, type ImportDeps } from "../src/imports/context";
import { createImportFiles } from "../src/imports/files";
import { firstBytesVerdict, receiveChunk, type ChunkRequest } from "../src/imports/flows/chunk";
import type { ImportRepo, ImportRow } from "../src/imports/repo";
import { MemoryStore } from "../src/middleware/rate-limit";

/**
 * The chunked upload (3b design, section 7.3; 12.2): the chunk flow over real files in a temporary import-archives, with
 * a repository that keeps one row in memory as the database's statements would (a move names the state and the size it
 * leaves). Chunks here are 16 bytes, the flow's test seam, so every rule of a chunk is tried on a few bytes; the
 * integration file http-imports.test.ts sends chunks of the real 8 MiB.
 */

const CHUNK = 16;
const OWNER = randomUUID();
const KEY = "ab".repeat(32);
const roots: string[] = [];
afterAll(() => {
  for (const root of roots) rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
});

const sha = (bytes: Uint8Array) => createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex");
const stream = (bytes: Uint8Array) => new Response(bytes).body!;

/** A zip's local header, then filler: the first bytes of an X or Mastodon archive. */
function zipBytes(size: number): Uint8Array {
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(size);
  bytes.set([0x50, 0x4b, 0x03, 0x04], 0);
  for (let i = 4; i < size; i++) bytes[i] = (i * 7) % 251;
  return bytes;
}

/** A CAR's first bytes: a varint header length of 58, then a CBOR map of two entries. */
function carBytes(size: number): Uint8Array {
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(size);
  bytes.set([58, 0xa2], 0);
  for (let i = 2; i < size; i++) bytes[i] = (i * 13) % 251;
  return bytes;
}

interface Harness {
  deps: ImportDeps;
  row: ImportRow;
  part: string;
  root: string;
  send(at: number, bytes: Uint8Array, extra?: Partial<ChunkRequest>): Promise<{ receivedBytes: number }>;
  refusal(at: number, bytes: Uint8Array, extra?: Partial<ChunkRequest>): Promise<ImportError>;
}

function harness(options: { declared: number; source?: ImportSource; status?: ImportStatus; free?: number }): Harness {
  const root = mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(), "korbat-imports-chunk-"));
  roots.push(root);
  const files = createImportFiles({ archivesDir: path.join(root, "archives"), workDir: path.join(root, "work"), log: pino({ level: "silent" }), freeBytes: async () => options.free ?? 10 * 1024 ** 3 });
  // What files.prepare() makes when the API starts.
  for (const dir of [files.archives.jobs, files.archives.queue, files.archives.deletions]) mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  const row: ImportRow = {
    id: randomUUID(),
    ownerId: OWNER,
    source: options.source ?? "mastodon",
    status: options.status ?? "uploading",
    declaredBytes: options.declared,
    receivedBytes: 0,
    createdAt: new Date("2026-10-26T10:00:00.000Z"),
    uploadedAt: null,
    scannedAt: null,
    confirmedAt: null,
    endedAt: null,
    failure: null,
    stopReason: null,
    staffRuleId: null,
    refusedAtOriginal: null,
    refusedWords: null,
    scan: null,
    choice: null,
    postsPublished: 0,
    imagesKept: 0,
    imagesLeftOut: 0,
    postsRemoved: 0,
    images: false,
  };
  // What the statements of repo.ts do to the one row: each move names the state and the size it leaves.
  const repo = {
    find: async (id: string, ownerId: string) => (id === row.id && ownerId === OWNER ? { ...row } : null),
    setReceived: async (_id: string, _owner: string, from: number, to: number) => {
      if (row.status !== "uploading" || row.receivedBytes !== from) return false;
      row.receivedBytes = to;
      return true;
    },
    completeUpload: async (_id: string, _owner: string, from: number) => {
      if (row.status !== "uploading" || row.receivedBytes !== from) return false;
      row.status = "scanning";
      row.receivedBytes = row.declaredBytes;
      return true;
    },
    failUpload: async (_id: string, _owner: string, failure: "tar_gz" | "not_an_archive") => {
      if (row.status !== "uploading") return false;
      row.status = "failed";
      row.failure = failure;
      return true;
    },
    accountKey: async () => KEY,
  } as unknown as ImportRepo;
  const deps = {
    repo,
    files,
    limits: new MemoryStore(),
    settings: { imports: true, images: false, sources: ["x", "mastodon"], maxActive: 2, imagesPerHour: 600, minFreeBytes: 1024 },
    log: pino({ level: "silent" }),
    now: () => new Date(),
    chunkBytes: CHUNK,
    inFlight: new Set<string>(),
  } as unknown as ImportDeps;
  const request = (at: number, bytes: Uint8Array, extra: Partial<ChunkRequest> = {}): ChunkRequest => ({ offset: String(at), length: String(bytes.length), sha256: sha(bytes), body: stream(bytes), ...extra });
  const h: Harness = {
    deps,
    row,
    root,
    part: files.archives.part(row.id),
    send: (at, bytes, extra) => receiveChunk(deps, OWNER, row.id, request(at, bytes, extra)),
    async refusal(at, bytes, extra) {
      const err = await receiveChunk(deps, OWNER, row.id, request(at, bytes, extra)).then(
        () => null,
        (caught: unknown) => caught,
      );
      expect(err).toBeInstanceOf(ImportError);
      return err as ImportError;
    },
  };
  return h;
}

const sizeOf = (file: string) => (existsSync(file) ? statSync(file).size : null);

/** The refusal a call ends in; a call that is taken fails the test. */
const refusedWith = (call: Promise<unknown>): Promise<ImportError> =>
  call.then(
    () => {
      throw new Error("the chunk was taken");
    },
    (err: unknown) => err as ImportError,
  );

describe("the chunk flow (7.3)", () => {
  test("chunks of exactly the chunk size at the stored offset, the last one shorter, complete the archive: renamed, job.json, the queue marker, scanning", async () => {
    const archive = zipBytes(40);
    const h = harness({ declared: 40 });
    expect(await h.send(0, archive.subarray(0, 16))).toEqual({ receivedBytes: 16 });
    expect(sizeOf(h.part)).toBe(16);
    expect(await h.send(16, archive.subarray(16, 32))).toEqual({ receivedBytes: 32 });
    expect(await h.send(32, archive.subarray(32))).toEqual({ receivedBytes: 40 });
    expect(h.row.status).toBe("scanning");
    expect(existsSync(h.part)).toBe(false);
    const layout = h.deps.files.archives;
    expect(new Uint8Array(readFileSync(layout.archive(h.row.id)))).toEqual(archive);
    const job = JobFile.parse(JSON.parse(readFileSync(layout.job(h.row.id), "utf8")));
    expect(job).toEqual({ v: 1, id: h.row.id, source: "mastodon", accountKey: KEY, images: false, createdAt: "2026-10-26T10:00:00.000Z" });
    expect(existsSync(layout.queued(h.row.id))).toBe(true);
    // The import moved on: a chunk now is wrong_state.
    expect((await h.refusal(40, archive.subarray(0, 1))).code).toBe("wrong_state");
  });

  test("an archive of one chunk shorter than the chunk size completes at once", async () => {
    const archive = zipBytes(5);
    const h = harness({ declared: 5 });
    expect(await h.send(0, archive)).toEqual({ receivedBytes: 5 });
    expect(h.row.status).toBe("scanning");
  });

  test("an offset that is not the stored size is wrong_offset with the stored size, and nothing is written", async () => {
    const archive = zipBytes(48);
    const h = harness({ declared: 48 });
    await h.send(0, archive.subarray(0, 16));
    for (const at of [0, 32, 17]) {
      const err = await h.refusal(at, archive.subarray(at, at + 16));
      expect([err.code, err.status, err.details]).toEqual(["wrong_offset", 409, { receivedBytes: 16 }]);
    }
    expect(sizeOf(h.part)).toBe(16);
  });

  test("a length over the chunk size, a short chunk that does not end the archive, one past the declared size or none at all is chunk_too_large", async () => {
    const archive = zipBytes(40);
    const h = harness({ declared: 40 });
    expect((await h.refusal(0, zipBytes(17))).code).toBe("chunk_too_large");
    expect((await h.refusal(0, archive.subarray(0, 15))).code).toBe("chunk_too_large");
    expect((await h.refusal(0, archive.subarray(0, 16), { length: undefined })).code).toBe("chunk_too_large");
    await h.send(0, archive.subarray(0, 16));
    await h.send(16, archive.subarray(16, 32));
    // 9 bytes would end at 41, past the declared 40.
    const err = await h.refusal(32, zipBytes(9));
    expect([err.code, err.status]).toEqual(["chunk_too_large", 413]);
    expect(sizeOf(h.part)).toBe(32);
  });

  test("a hash that differs, a short body, a body longer than its length and one that breaks off leave archive.part at the stored size (chunk_mismatch)", async () => {
    const archive = zipBytes(48);
    const h = harness({ declared: 48 });
    await h.send(0, archive.subarray(0, 16));
    const next = archive.subarray(16, 32);
    expect((await h.refusal(16, next, { sha256: sha(archive.subarray(0, 16)) })).code).toBe("chunk_mismatch");
    expect(sizeOf(h.part)).toBe(16);
    expect((await h.refusal(16, next, { body: stream(next.subarray(0, 10)) })).code).toBe("chunk_mismatch");
    expect(sizeOf(h.part)).toBe(16);
    expect((await h.refusal(16, next, { body: stream(zipBytes(20)) })).code).toBe("chunk_mismatch");
    expect(sizeOf(h.part)).toBe(16);
    const broken = new ReadableStream<Uint8Array>({
      start(controller) {
        controller.enqueue(next.subarray(0, 8));
        controller.error(new Error("the connection was lost"));
      },
    });
    const err = await h.refusal(16, next, { body: broken });
    expect([err.code, err.status]).toEqual(["chunk_mismatch", 400]);
    expect(sizeOf(h.part)).toBe(16);
    // The same chunk sent again whole is taken.
    expect(await h.send(16, next)).toEqual({ receivedBytes: 32 });
  });

  test("malformed headers are invalid_request; an import not the caller's is not_found; one that is not uploading is wrong_state", async () => {
    const h = harness({ declared: 40 });
    const chunk = zipBytes(16);
    expect((await h.refusal(0, chunk, { offset: "-1" })).code).toBe("invalid_request");
    expect((await h.refusal(0, chunk, { offset: "1e3" })).code).toBe("invalid_request");
    expect((await h.refusal(0, chunk, { sha256: sha(chunk).toUpperCase() })).code).toBe("invalid_request");
    expect((await h.refusal(0, chunk, { sha256: undefined })).code).toBe("invalid_request");
    const other = await refusedWith(receiveChunk(h.deps, randomUUID(), h.row.id, { offset: "0", length: "16", sha256: sha(chunk), body: stream(chunk) }));
    expect([other.code, other.status]).toEqual(["not_found", 404]);
    const done = harness({ declared: 40, status: "scanning" });
    expect((await done.refusal(0, chunk)).code).toBe("wrong_state");
  });

  test("the first chunk's first bytes: a zip for X and Mastodon, a CAR for Bluesky; gzip ends the upload as tar_gz, anything else as not_an_archive, and nothing is kept", async () => {
    expect(firstBytesVerdict("x", zipBytes(16))).toBe("ok");
    expect(firstBytesVerdict("mastodon", zipBytes(4))).toBe("ok");
    expect(firstBytesVerdict("bluesky", carBytes(16))).toBe("ok");
    expect(firstBytesVerdict("bluesky", zipBytes(16))).toBe("not_an_archive");
    expect(firstBytesVerdict("x", carBytes(16))).toBe("not_an_archive");
    expect(firstBytesVerdict("x", new Uint8Array([0x1f, 0x8b, 8, 0]))).toBe("tar_gz");
    expect(firstBytesVerdict("bluesky", new Uint8Array([0x1f, 0x8b, 8, 0]))).toBe("tar_gz");
    // An empty zip's end record, and a CAR header too long for a block, are no archives to scan.
    expect(firstBytesVerdict("x", new Uint8Array([0x50, 0x4b, 0x05, 0x06]))).toBe("not_an_archive");
    expect(firstBytesVerdict("bluesky", new Uint8Array([0xff, 0xff, 0x7f, 0xa2]))).toBe("not_an_archive");

    const gzip = harness({ declared: 40 });
    const tar = new Uint8Array(16);
    tar.set([0x1f, 0x8b, 8, 0]);
    const err = await gzip.refusal(0, tar);
    expect([err.code, err.status]).toEqual(["not_an_archive", 400]);
    expect([gzip.row.status, gzip.row.failure]).toEqual(["failed", "tar_gz"]);
    expect(existsSync(gzip.deps.files.archives.jobDir(gzip.row.id))).toBe(false);

    const plain = harness({ declared: 40, source: "bluesky" });
    expect((await plain.refusal(0, zipBytes(16))).code).toBe("not_an_archive");
    expect([plain.row.status, plain.row.failure]).toEqual(["failed", "not_an_archive"]);

    const car = harness({ declared: 20, source: "bluesky" });
    expect(await car.send(0, carBytes(16))).toEqual({ receivedBytes: 16 });
  });

  test("a row behind its file takes the file's size up to whole chunks, never the last one, and the file is cut back to it", async () => {
    const archive = zipBytes(56);
    const h = harness({ declared: 56 });
    await h.send(0, archive.subarray(0, 16));
    // The process stopped after a second chunk was written and before its update, and a third was half written.
    writeFileSync(h.part, archive.subarray(0, 40));
    const err = await h.refusal(16, archive.subarray(16, 32));
    expect([err.code, err.details]).toEqual(["wrong_offset", { receivedBytes: 32 }]);
    expect(h.row.receivedBytes).toBe(32);
    expect(sizeOf(h.part)).toBe(32);
    expect(await h.send(32, archive.subarray(32, 48))).toEqual({ receivedBytes: 48 });
    // The last chunk written but never answered: it is sent again, since its request also completes the archive.
    writeFileSync(h.part, archive);
    expect((await h.refusal(56, archive.subarray(0, 1))).details).toEqual({ receivedBytes: 48 });
    expect(sizeOf(h.part)).toBe(48);
    expect(await h.send(48, archive.subarray(48))).toEqual({ receivedBytes: 56 });
    expect(h.row.status).toBe("scanning");
  });

  test("a file shorter than its row cannot go on: imports_unavailable, and the file is left as it is", async () => {
    const archive = zipBytes(48);
    const h = harness({ declared: 48 });
    await h.send(0, archive.subarray(0, 16));
    writeFileSync(h.part, archive.subarray(0, 8));
    expect((await h.refusal(16, archive.subarray(16, 32))).code).toBe("imports_unavailable");
    expect(sizeOf(h.part)).toBe(8);
  });

  test("free space under IMPORT_MIN_FREE_BYTES refuses a chunk with imports_unavailable (503)", async () => {
    const h = harness({ declared: 40, free: 1023 });
    const err = await h.refusal(0, zipBytes(16));
    expect([err.code, err.status]).toEqual(["imports_unavailable", 503]);
    expect(existsSync(h.part)).toBe(false);
  });

  test("a second chunk of an import while one is on its way in is wrong_offset; each one is counted in import-chunk, 600 an hour", async () => {
    const archive = zipBytes(40);
    const h = harness({ declared: 40 });
    let release: () => void = () => undefined;
    const slow = new ReadableStream<Uint8Array>({
      async start(controller) {
        controller.enqueue(archive.subarray(0, 8));
        await new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
          release = resolve;
        });
        controller.enqueue(archive.subarray(8, 16));
        controller.close();
      },
    });
    const first = h.send(0, archive.subarray(0, 16), { body: slow });
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 50));
    expect((await h.refusal(0, archive.subarray(0, 16))).code).toBe("wrong_offset");
    release();
    expect(await first).toEqual({ receivedBytes: 16 });

    // Counted after the headers are read and before the import is: a chunk of nobody's import counts too.
    const limited = harness({ declared: 40 });
    const nobody = { offset: "0", length: "16", sha256: sha(zipBytes(16)) };
    for (let i = 0; i < IMPORT_RULES.chunksPerHour; i++) await receiveChunk(limited.deps, OWNER, randomUUID(), { ...nobody, body: stream(zipBytes(16)) }).catch(() => undefined);
    const err = await refusedWith(receiveChunk(limited.deps, OWNER, limited.row.id, { ...nobody, body: stream(zipBytes(16)) }));
    expect([err.code, err.status]).toEqual(["rate_limited", 429]);
    expect(err.retryAfterSeconds).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/imports-intake.test.ts`

```ts
import { createHash, randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { mkdirSync, mkdtempSync, renameSync, rmdirSync, rmSync, symlinkSync, unlinkSync } from "node:fs";
import { open } from "node:fs/promises";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import path from "node:path";
import pino from "pino";
import { afterAll, describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { IMPORT_RULES, ImportScanFacts, type ImportedPost } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { LINE_MAX_BYTES, parsePostLine, readLineAt, workLayout, writeScanOutput } from "@korbat/import-protocol";
import { createImportFiles } from "../src/imports/files";
import { marksOf, runIntake, type IntakeOptions, type ScannedSummary } from "../src/imports/intake";

/**
 * The intake (3b design, section 7.5 step 2; 12.2), over scan output that packages/import-protocol's writeScanOutput writes
 * as the importer would, read through the API's own files module. The social module's read of keys already imported is
 * a set the test gives.
 */

const roots: string[] = [];
afterAll(() => {
  for (const root of roots) rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
});

const CREATED = new Date("2026-10-26T10:00:00.000Z");
const keyOf = (ref: number) => createHash("sha256").update(`key ${ref}`).digest("hex");

/** One line as the importer writes it, dated in March, April or May of 2019 by its ref unless told otherwise. */
function post(ref: number, over: Partial<ImportedPost> = {}): ImportedPost {
  const month = ["03", "04", "05"][Math.floor(ref / 40) % 3]!;
  const day = String((ref % 28) + 1).padStart(2, "0");
  return { ref, key: keyOf(ref), at: `2019-${month}-${day}T12:00:00Z`, kind: "post", parent: null, text: `post number ${ref}`, media: [], protected: false, warning: false, ...over };
}

function summaryOf(id: string, posts: number, over: Partial<ScannedSummary> = {}): ScannedSummary {
  return { v: 1, id, status: "scanned", posts, images: 0, skipped: {}, imagesSkipped: {}, cleaned: 0, warnings: 0, sourceLinks: 0, protectedPosts: 0, readInPart: false, ...over };
}

function volume(options: { workDevice?: number } = {}) {
  const root = mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(), "korbat-imports-intake-"));
  roots.push(root);
  const files = createImportFiles({ archivesDir: path.join(root, "archives"), workDir: path.join(root, "work"), log: pino({ level: "silent" }), ...options });
  return { root, files, id: randomUUID() };
}

type Volume = ReturnType<typeof volume>;

function intake(v: Volume, summary: ScannedSummary, over: Partial<IntakeOptions> = {}) {
  return runIntake({ id: v.id, summary, images: false, createdAt: CREATED, young: false, known: async () => new Set(), files: v.files, log: pino({ level: "silent" }), ...over });
}

/** The line at an offset of posts.jsonl, read as the preview reads a sample. */
async function lineAt(v: Volume, offset: number): Promise<ImportedPost | null> {
  const handle = await open(v.files.work.posts(v.id), "r");
  try {
    const text = await readLineAt(handle, offset);
    return text === null ? null : parsePostLine(text);
  } finally {
    await handle.close();
  }
}

describe("the intake (7.5 step 2)", () => {
  test("the month table by month and marks, the three newest lines as samples and every fiftieth line's offset as the pages", async () => {
    const v = volume();
    const long = "word ".repeat(220);
    const posts = Array.from({ length: 120 }, (_, ref) => {
      if (ref % 10 === 1) return post(ref, { kind: "reply" });
      if (ref % 10 === 2) return post(ref, { text: long, warning: true });
      if (ref % 10 === 3) return post(ref, { protected: true });
      return post(ref);
    });
    writeScanOutput(v.files.work.root, posts, summaryOf(v.id, 120, { warnings: 12, protectedPosts: 12, cleaned: 3 }));
    const result = await intake(v, summaryOf(v.id, 120, { warnings: 12, protectedPosts: 12, cleaned: 3 }));
    if (!result.ok) throw new Error(result.code);
    const scan = ImportScanFacts.parse(result.scan);
    expect(scan.posts).toBe(120);
    expect([scan.first, scan.last, scan.fromRef]).toEqual(["2019-03", "2019-05", 0]);
    expect([scan.warnings, scan.protectedPosts, scan.cleaned]).toEqual([12, 12, 3]);
    // Forty lines a month: four of each ten carry a mark, one each of reply, long and warning together, protected.
    expect(scan.months).toEqual(
      ["2019-03", "2019-04", "2019-05"].map((month) => ({
        month,
        groups: [
          [0, 28, 0, 0],
          [1, 4, 0, 0],
          [2 | 4, 4, 0, 0],
          [8, 4, 0, 0],
        ],
      })),
    );
    expect(scan.samples.map((sample) => sample.ref)).toEqual([119, 118, 117]);
    for (const sample of scan.samples) expect((await lineAt(v, sample.offset))?.ref).toBe(sample.ref);
    expect(scan.pages).toHaveLength(3);
    expect(await Promise.all(scan.pages.map(async (offset) => (await lineAt(v, offset))?.ref))).toEqual([0, 50, 100]);
    expect(scan.skipped).toEqual({});
  });

  test("a line that is not JSON, not the contract, out of its place, dated outside the range or over 256 KiB is unreadable; the lines after it are read", async () => {
    const v = volume();
    const lines: (ImportedPost | string)[] = [post(0), "{not json", JSON.stringify({ ...post(2), extra: true }), post(4), post(4), "x".repeat(LINE_MAX_BYTES + 1), post(6, { at: "2006-03-20T23:59:59Z" }), post(7, { at: "2026-10-27T10:00:01Z" }), post(8, { at: "2026-10-27T10:00:00Z" }), post(9)];
    writeScanOutput(v.files.work.root, lines, summaryOf(v.id, 10, { skipped: { not_public: 4, unreadable: 1 } }));
    const result = await intake(v, summaryOf(v.id, 10, { skipped: { not_public: 4, unreadable: 1 } }));
    if (!result.ok) throw new Error(result.code);
    // Lines 1, 2, 3 (ref 4 in place 3), 5 (over the cap), 6 (before the first tweet) and 7 (more than a day after the
    // import's creation) are unreadable; the importer's own unreadable count is added.
    expect(result.scan.posts).toBe(4);
    expect(result.scan.skipped).toEqual({ unreadable: 7, not_public: 4 });
    expect(result.scan.samples.map((sample) => sample.ref)).toEqual([9, 8, 4]);
  });

  test("a note of 75 KB in CJK characters is one readable line, marked long", async () => {
    const v = volume();
    const note = Array.from({ length: 25_000 }, (_, i) => String.fromCharCode(0x4e00 + (i % 500))).join("");
    expect(Buffer.byteLength(note)).toBe(75_000);
    writeScanOutput(v.files.work.root, [post(0, { text: note })], summaryOf(v.id, 1));
    const result = await intake(v, summaryOf(v.id, 1));
    if (!result.ok) throw new Error(result.code);
    expect(result.scan.posts).toBe(1);
    expect(result.scan.months[0]!.groups).toEqual([[2, 1, 0, 0]]);
    expect(marksOf(post(0, { text: note }))).toBe(2);
  });

  test("lines the account already imported are counted and left out; a young account offers its newest lines only, from fromRef", async () => {
    const v = volume();
    writeScanOutput(v.files.work.root, Array.from({ length: 30 }, (_, ref) => post(ref)), summaryOf(v.id, 30));
    const asked: number[] = [];
    const known = async (keys: readonly string[]) => {
      asked.push(keys.length);
      return new Set([keyOf(1), keyOf(25), keyOf(29)]);
    };
    const old = await intake(v, summaryOf(v.id, 30), { known });
    if (!old.ok) throw new Error(old.code);
    expect([old.scan.posts, old.scan.fromRef, old.scan.skipped]).toEqual([27, 0, { already_imported: 3 }]);
    expect(old.scan.samples.map((sample) => sample.ref)).toEqual([28, 27, 26]);
    expect(asked).toEqual([30]);
    // The ten newest of the 27 offered: refs 18 to 28 but 25.
    const young = await intake(v, summaryOf(v.id, 30), { known, young: true, caps: { newAccountPosts: 10 } });
    if (!young.ok) throw new Error(young.code);
    expect([young.scan.posts, young.scan.fromRef, young.scan.skipped]).toEqual([10, 18, { already_imported: 3, new_account_cap: 17 }]);
    expect(young.scan.months.flatMap((month) => month.groups).reduce((sum, group) => sum + group[1], 0)).toBe(10);
  });

  test("keys are asked in batches of a thousand", async () => {
    const v = volume();
    writeScanOutput(v.files.work.root, Array.from({ length: 2_001 }, (_, ref) => post(ref)), summaryOf(v.id, 2_001));
    const asked: number[] = [];
    const result = await intake(v, summaryOf(v.id, 2_001), {
      known: async (keys) => {
        asked.push(keys.length);
        return new Set();
      },
    });
    expect(result.ok && result.scan.posts).toBe(2_001);
    expect(asked).toEqual([IMPORT_RULES.keyBatch, IMPORT_RULES.keyBatch, 1]);
  });

  test("images: each named file must open within 20 MiB or it is missing_file; images without a source's description are counted; beyond the cap over_image_cap; with images off a line's media are images_off", async () => {
    const v = volume();
    const jpeg = new Uint8Array([0xff, 0xd8, 0xff, 0xe0, 1, 2, 3]);
    const posts = [
      post(0, { media: [{ file: "0-0.jpg", alt: "A described photo" }, { file: "0-1.jpg", alt: null }] }),
      post(1, { media: [{ file: "1-0.jpg", alt: null }] }),
      post(2, { media: [{ file: "2-0.png", alt: "Gone" }] }),
    ];
    writeScanOutput(v.files.work.root, posts, summaryOf(v.id, 3, { images: 4, imagesSkipped: { video: 2 } }), { "0-0.jpg": jpeg, "0-1.jpg": jpeg, "1-0.jpg": jpeg });
    const on = await intake(v, summaryOf(v.id, 3, { images: 4, imagesSkipped: { video: 2 } }), { images: true });
    if (!on.ok) throw new Error(on.code);
    expect([on.scan.images, on.scan.imagesSkipped]).toEqual([3, { missing_file: 1, video: 2 }]);
    expect(on.scan.months).toEqual([{ month: "2019-03", groups: [[0, 3, 3, 2]] }]);
    // The cap keeps the newest posts' images first: ref 1's, then ref 0's first.
    const capped = await intake(v, summaryOf(v.id, 3), { images: true, caps: { images: 2 } });
    if (!capped.ok) throw new Error(capped.code);
    expect([capped.scan.images, capped.scan.imagesSkipped]).toEqual([2, { missing_file: 1, over_image_cap: 1 }]);
    expect(capped.scan.months[0]!.groups).toEqual([[0, 3, 2, 1]]);
    const off = await intake(v, summaryOf(v.id, 3), { images: false });
    if (!off.ok) throw new Error(off.code);
    expect([off.scan.images, off.scan.imagesSkipped]).toEqual([0, { images_off: 4 }]);
  });

  test("a posts.jsonl that is no regular file of the work volume is refused: a symlinked folder, a symlinked file, another device, none at all", async () => {
    const v = volume();
    writeScanOutput(v.files.work.root, [post(0)], summaryOf(v.id, 1));
    expect((await intake(v, summaryOf(v.id, 1))).ok).toBe(true);

    // The job's folder as a link (a junction on Windows) to a folder that holds a good posts.jsonl.
    const elsewhere = path.join(v.root, "elsewhere");
    renameSync(v.files.work.jobDir(v.id), elsewhere);
    symlinkSync(elsewhere, v.files.work.jobDir(v.id), "junction");
    expect(await intake(v, summaryOf(v.id, 1))).toEqual({ ok: false, code: "symlink" });
    // The link alone goes, never what it names: unlink, or rmdir for a junction where unlink is refused.
    try {
      unlinkSync(v.files.work.jobDir(v.id));
    } catch {
      rmdirSync(v.files.work.jobDir(v.id));
    }

    // posts.jsonl itself as a link: Windows without developer mode cannot make one.
    mkdirSync(v.files.work.jobDir(v.id), { recursive: true });
    let linked = true;
    try {
      symlinkSync(path.join(elsewhere, "posts.jsonl"), v.files.work.posts(v.id));
    } catch (err) {
      if ((err as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code !== "EPERM" || process.platform !== "win32") throw err;
      linked = false;
    }
    if (linked) expect(await intake(v, summaryOf(v.id, 1))).toEqual({ ok: false, code: "symlink" });
    expect(await intake(volumeWith(v, -1), summaryOf(v.id, 1))).toEqual({ ok: false, code: "other_device" });
    const empty = volume();
    expect(await intake(empty, summaryOf(empty.id, 1))).toEqual({ ok: false, code: "missing" });
  });
});

/** The same volume read as if its mount root were on another device. */
function volumeWith(v: Volume, workDevice: number): Volume {
  const files = createImportFiles({ archivesDir: path.join(v.root, "archives"), workDir: workLayout(v.files.work.root).root, log: pino({ level: "silent" }), workDevice });
  return { ...v, files };
}
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/http-imports.test.ts`

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { existsSync } from "node:fs";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { ErrorEnvelope, IMPORT_RULES, ImportView } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { randomIp, type Browser } from "./http-client";
import { importsHarness, sha256, zipArchive, type ImportsHarness } from "./imports-harness";
import { suspendRowForTest } from "./moderation-fixtures";

// Each test signs accounts up over HTTP and one sends an archive of more than 8 MiB: slow on a loaded machine.
vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 120_000 });

/**
 * The imports routes over HTTP (3b design, sections 4.2, 7.3, 9.2 and 9.4; 12.3): the creation and each of its refusals
 * in 4.2's order, the chunks through the app with their sizes and a resume, the cancel, the list, someone else's import,
 * and every refusal answered with its status, never 500.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: imports over HTTP", () => {
  let h: ImportsHarness;
  beforeAll(async () => {
    h = await importsHarness();
  });
  afterAll(async () => {
    await h?.close();
  });

  const refusal = async (res: Response) => [res.status, ErrorEnvelope.parse(await res.json()).error.code];
  /** The uploads and scans on the site now, which the site's cap counts. */
  const siteActive = async () => (await h.migrateDb.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from import_jobs where status in ('uploading', 'scanning')`))[0]!.n;

  test("a creation is an import in uploading of the declared size, with the chunk size, of the account alone; the account's key is made once", async () => {
    const { b, id } = await h.signUp();
    const res = await h.create(b, { source: "x", bytes: 1234 });
    expect(res.status).toBe(201);
    const view = ImportView.parse(await res.json());
    expect(view).toMatchObject({ source: "x", status: "uploading", declaredBytes: 1234, receivedBytes: 0, chunkBytes: IMPORT_RULES.chunkBytes, failure: null, scan: null, samples: [], picks: [], undoable: false, paused: false });
    expect((await h.row(view.id))?.images).toBe(false);
    expect(existsSync(h.archives.jobDir(view.id))).toBe(true);
    const [key] = await h.migrateDb.execute<{ n: number; bytes: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n, max(octet_length(key))::int as bytes from import_keys where owner_id = ${id}::uuid`);
    expect({ ...key }).toEqual({ n: 1, bytes: IMPORT_RULES.keyBytes });
    // Someone else's import is no import at all.
    const other = await h.signUp();
    expect(await refusal(await other.b.fetch(`/api/imports/${view.id}`))).toEqual([404, "not_found"]);
    expect(await refusal(await h.chunk(other.b, view.id, 0, zipArchive(1234)))).toEqual([404, "not_found"]);
    expect(await refusal(await other.b.fetch(`/api/imports/${view.id}/cancel`, { method: "POST" }))).toEqual([404, "not_found"]);
    expect(await refusal(await b.fetch("/api/imports/not-an-import"))).toEqual([404, "not_found"]);
    // A second creation while it is active.
    expect(await refusal(await h.create(b))).toEqual([409, "import_active"]);
    // Cancelled, the account may start again, and its key stays the one it had.
    expect((await b.fetch(`/api/imports/${view.id}/cancel`, { method: "POST" })).status).toBe(200);
    const again = await h.created(b);
    const [still] = await h.migrateDb.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from import_keys where owner_id = ${id}::uuid`);
    expect(still!.n).toBe(1);
    expect((await b.fetch(`/api/imports/${again.id}/cancel`, { method: "POST" })).status).toBe(200);
  });

  test("the refusals of a creation, in 4.2's order: the size first, then the switches, the suspension, the account's age, and a body that is no request", async () => {
    const young = await h.signUp({ ageDays: 6 });
    // 2 GiB and one byte: archive_too_large before anything else is looked at, even for an account too young.
    expect(await refusal(await h.create(young.b, { source: "mastodon", bytes: IMPORT_RULES.maxBytes + 1 }))).toEqual([413, "archive_too_large"]);
    expect(await refusal(await h.create(young.b, { source: "mastodon", bytes: 0 }))).toEqual([400, "invalid_request"]);
    expect(await refusal(await h.create(young.b, { source: "threads", bytes: 10 }))).toEqual([400, "invalid_request"]);
    // A source switched off, and imports switched off, answer as the site's: before the account is read.
    h.settings.sources = ["x"];
    expect(await refusal(await h.create(young.b, { source: "mastodon", bytes: 10 }))).toEqual([503, "imports_unavailable"]);
    h.settings.sources = ["x", "mastodon"];
    h.settings.imports = false;
    expect(await refusal(await h.create(young.b, { source: "x", bytes: 10 }))).toEqual([503, "imports_unavailable"]);
    h.settings.imports = true;
    // Six days old: too soon. Suspended as well: the suspension answers first.
    expect(await refusal(await h.create(young.b))).toEqual([403, "import_too_soon"]);
    await suspendRowForTest(h.migrateDb, young.id);
    expect(await refusal(await h.create(young.b))).toEqual([403, "account_suspended"]);
    // At seven days it would be taken, but for the suspension.
    await h.age(young.id, 7);
    expect(await refusal(await h.create(young.b))).toEqual([403, "account_suspended"]);
    const [rows] = await h.migrateDb.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from import_jobs where owner_id = ${young.id}::uuid`);
    expect(rows!.n).toBe(0);
  });

  test("three published imports in seven days refuse a fourth with import_weekly_limit and Retry-After; failed, cancelled and unpublished ones cost nothing", async () => {
    const { b, id } = await h.signUp({ ageDays: 40 });
    // Rows written as the migrator, whose insert import_jobs_insert leaves as it is: past imports in their end states.
    const job = (status: string, confirmed: string | null, published: number, ends: { failure?: string; stop?: string } = {}) =>
      h.migrateDb.execute(sql`insert into import_jobs (id, owner_id, source, declared_bytes, status, confirmed_at, posts_published, ended_at, failure, stop_reason)
                              values (${randomUUID()}::uuid, ${id}::uuid, 'mastodon', 100, ${status}::import_status, ${confirmed === null ? null : sql`now() - ${confirmed}::interval`},
                                      ${published}, now(), ${ends.failure ?? null}, ${ends.stop ?? null})`);
    await job("done", "1 day", 10);
    await job("stopped", "2 days", 5, { stop: "by_author" });
    // These cost nothing: a failed scan, a cancel, an import done with nothing published, one published eight days ago.
    await job("failed", null, 0, { failure: "unreadable" });
    await job("cancelled", null, 0);
    await job("done", "1 day", 0);
    await job("done", "8 days", 50);
    const third = await h.created(b);
    expect((await b.fetch(`/api/imports/${third.id}/cancel`, { method: "POST" })).status).toBe(200);
    await job("undone", "3 days", 7);
    const res = await h.create(b);
    expect(await refusal(res)).toEqual([429, "import_weekly_limit"]);
    // The oldest of the three leaves the window in four days.
    const wait = Number(res.headers.get("retry-after"));
    expect(wait).toBeGreaterThan(4 * 86_400 - 120);
    expect(wait).toBeLessThanOrEqual(4 * 86_400);
  });

  test("five imports a day from one address: the sixth is rate_limited, and a creation refused for another reason costs the address nothing", async () => {
    const ip = randomIp();
    const tooYoung = await h.signUp({ ip, ageDays: 3 });
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) expect(await refusal(await h.create(tooYoung.b))).toEqual([403, "import_too_soon"]);
    const views: { b: Browser; id: string }[] = [];
    h.settings.maxActive = 100;
    for (let i = 0; i < IMPORT_RULES.importsPerAddressDay; i++) {
      const { b } = await h.signUp({ ip });
      views.push({ b, id: (await h.created(b)).id });
    }
    const sixth = await h.signUp({ ip });
    const res = await h.create(sixth.b);
    expect(await refusal(res)).toEqual([429, "rate_limited"]);
    expect(Number(res.headers.get("retry-after"))).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    // Another address is not counted with this one.
    const elsewhere = await h.signUp();
    const taken = await h.created(elsewhere.b);
    for (const view of [...views, { b: elsewhere.b, id: taken.id }]) expect((await view.b.fetch(`/api/imports/${view.id}/cancel`, { method: "POST" })).status).toBe(200);
    h.settings.maxActive = IMPORT_RULES.maxActiveDefault;
  });

  test("the site's uploads and scans are capped under a lock: of two creations at once by two accounts at the cap, one is refused", async () => {
    const ada = await h.signUp();
    const bob = await h.signUp();
    h.settings.maxActive = (await siteActive()) + 1;
    try {
      const answers = await Promise.all([h.create(ada.b), h.create(bob.b)]);
      expect(answers.map((res) => res.status).sort()).toEqual([201, 503]);
      const refused = answers.find((res) => res.status === 503)!;
      expect(ErrorEnvelope.parse(await refused.json()).error.code).toBe("imports_unavailable");
      const taken = ImportView.parse(await answers.find((res) => res.status === 201)!.json());
      const owner = answers[0]!.status === 201 ? ada : bob;
      expect((await owner.b.fetch(`/api/imports/${taken.id}/cancel`, { method: "POST" })).status).toBe(200);
    } finally {
      h.settings.maxActive = IMPORT_RULES.maxActiveDefault;
    }
  });

  test("the importer's heartbeat older than 60 seconds, or free space under the archive, the 4 GiB of its scan and the floor, refuse with imports_unavailable", async () => {
    const { b } = await h.signUp();
    h.beat(Date.now() - 61_000);
    expect(await refusal(await h.create(b))).toEqual([503, "imports_unavailable"]);
    h.beat();
    const need = 100 + IMPORT_RULES.scanWriteBytes + h.settings.minFreeBytes;
    h.setFree(need - 1);
    expect(await refusal(await h.create(b, { source: "mastodon", bytes: 100 }))).toEqual([503, "imports_unavailable"]);
    h.setFree(need);
    const view = await h.created(b, { source: "mastodon", bytes: 100 });
    h.setFree(64 * 1024 ** 3);
    expect((await b.fetch(`/api/imports/${view.id}/cancel`, { method: "POST" })).status).toBe(200);
  });

  test("chunks over HTTP: 8 MiB at the stored offset, a refused chunk resumed from the stored size, sizes over the rules refused; the last completes the archive", async () => {
    const { b } = await h.signUp();
    const archive = zipArchive(IMPORT_RULES.chunkBytes + 1000);
    const view = await h.created(b, { source: "mastodon", bytes: archive.length });
    const first = archive.subarray(0, IMPORT_RULES.chunkBytes);
    const last = archive.subarray(IMPORT_RULES.chunkBytes);
    // A first chunk shorter than 8 MiB that does not end the archive, and a body over the chunk's size, are refused.
    expect(await refusal(await h.chunk(b, view.id, 0, first.subarray(0, 1000)))).toEqual([413, "chunk_too_large"]);
    expect(await refusal(await h.chunk(b, view.id, 0, zipArchive(IMPORT_RULES.chunkBytes + 1)))).toEqual([413, "chunk_too_large"]);
    expect(await (await h.chunk(b, view.id, 0, first)).json()).toEqual({ receivedBytes: IMPORT_RULES.chunkBytes });
    // The same chunk again: the stored size tells the app where to go on.
    const wrong = await h.chunk(b, view.id, 0, first);
    expect(wrong.status).toBe(409);
    expect(ErrorEnvelope.parse(await wrong.json()).error).toMatchObject({ code: "wrong_offset", details: { receivedBytes: IMPORT_RULES.chunkBytes } });
    // A damaged last chunk is refused and leaves the file at 8 MiB; the app reads the import and sends it again.
    expect(await refusal(await h.chunk(b, view.id, IMPORT_RULES.chunkBytes, last, { "import-chunk-sha256": sha256(first) }))).toEqual([400, "chunk_mismatch"]);
    const resumed = ImportView.parse(await (await b.fetch(`/api/imports/${view.id}`)).json());
    expect([resumed.status, resumed.receivedBytes]).toEqual(["uploading", IMPORT_RULES.chunkBytes]);
    expect(await (await h.chunk(b, view.id, resumed.receivedBytes, last)).json()).toEqual({ receivedBytes: archive.length });
    const done = ImportView.parse(await (await b.fetch(`/api/imports/${view.id}`)).json());
    expect([done.status, done.receivedBytes]).toEqual(["scanning", archive.length]);
    const row = await h.row(view.id);
    expect(row?.uploaded_at).not.toBeNull();
    expect(existsSync(h.archives.archive(view.id)) && existsSync(h.archives.job(view.id)) && existsSync(h.archives.queued(view.id))).toBe(true);
    expect(existsSync(h.archives.part(view.id))).toBe(false);
    // No chunk is taken once the archive is complete; the JSON routes keep their 64 KiB.
    expect(await refusal(await h.chunk(b, view.id, archive.length, last))).toEqual([409, "wrong_state"]);
    expect(await refusal(await b.fetch("/api/imports", { json: { source: "mastodon", bytes: 10, pad: "x".repeat(70_000) } }))).toEqual([413, "payload_too_large"]);
    // A cancel while it waits for its scan takes the archive and its marker, and asks the importer to drop its work.
    const cancelled = ImportView.parse(await (await b.fetch(`/api/imports/${view.id}/cancel`, { method: "POST" })).json());
    expect([cancelled.status, cancelled.endedAt !== null]).toEqual(["cancelled", true]);
    expect((await h.row(view.id))?.scanned_at).not.toBeNull();
    expect(existsSync(h.archives.jobDir(view.id)) || existsSync(h.archives.queued(view.id))).toBe(false);
    expect(existsSync(h.archives.deletion(view.id))).toBe(true);
    expect(await refusal(await b.fetch(`/api/imports/${view.id}/cancel`, { method: "POST" }))).toEqual([409, "wrong_state"]);
  });

  test("a first chunk that is not an archive of the source fails the import: gzip as tar_gz, anything else as not_an_archive", async () => {
    const { b, id } = await h.signUp();
    const tar = new Uint8Array(64);
    tar.set([0x1f, 0x8b, 8, 0]);
    const view = await h.created(b, { source: "mastodon", bytes: 64 });
    expect(await refusal(await h.chunk(b, view.id, 0, tar))).toEqual([400, "not_an_archive"]);
    expect(await h.row(view.id)).toMatchObject({ status: "failed", failure: "tar_gz" });
    const plain = await h.created(b, { source: "x", bytes: 64 });
    expect(await refusal(await h.chunk(b, plain.id, 0, new Uint8Array(64).fill(65)))).toEqual([400, "not_an_archive"]);
    const failed = ImportView.parse(await (await b.fetch(`/api/imports/${plain.id}`)).json());
    expect([failed.status, failed.failure, failed.endedAt !== null]).toEqual(["failed", "not_an_archive", true]);
    expect(existsSync(h.archives.jobDir(plain.id))).toBe(false);
    const [rows] = await h.migrateDb.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from import_jobs where owner_id = ${id}::uuid and status = 'failed'`);
    expect(rows!.n).toBe(2);
  });

  test("the list: the account's imports newest first, at most 20, and the sources a new import may name", async () => {
    const { b, id } = await h.signUp();
    for (let i = 0; i < 21; i++) {
      await h.migrateDb.execute(sql`insert into import_jobs (id, owner_id, source, declared_bytes, status, ended_at, created_at)
                                     values (${randomUUID()}::uuid, ${id}::uuid, 'x', 100, 'cancelled', now(), now() - make_interval(mins => ${i + 1}))`);
    }
    const newest = await h.created(b);
    const list = (await (await b.fetch("/api/imports")).json()) as { imports: unknown[]; sources: string[] };
    const imports = list.imports.map((item) => ImportView.parse(item));
    expect(imports).toHaveLength(IMPORT_RULES.listMax);
    expect(imports[0]!.id).toBe(newest.id);
    expect(imports.slice(1).every((item) => item.status === "cancelled")).toBe(true);
    expect(list.sources).toEqual(["x", "mastodon"]);
    h.settings.imports = false;
    expect(((await (await b.fetch("/api/imports")).json()) as { sources: string[] }).sources).toEqual([]);
    h.settings.imports = true;
    const other = await h.signUp();
    expect(((await (await other.b.fetch("/api/imports")).json()) as { imports: unknown[] }).imports).toEqual([]);
    expect((await b.fetch(`/api/imports/${newest.id}/cancel`, { method: "POST" })).status).toBe(200);
  });

  test("the routes need a session and, for a cookie session, the CSRF header", async () => {
    const { b } = await h.signUp();
    const view = await h.created(b);
    expect((await h.app.request("/api/imports")).status).toBe(401);
    const res = await b.fetch(`/api/imports/${view.id}/cancel`, { method: "POST", csrf: false });
    expect(res.status).toBe(403);
    expect((await b.fetch(`/api/imports/${view.id}/cancel`, { method: "POST" })).status).toBe(200);
  });

  test("an account's cancels are counted: the 21st in an hour is rate_limited (import-act)", async () => {
    const { b } = await h.signUp();
    const nobody = randomUUID();
    for (let i = 0; i < IMPORT_RULES.actsPerHour; i++) expect(await refusal(await b.fetch(`/api/imports/${nobody}/cancel`, { method: "POST" }))).toEqual([404, "not_found"]);
    const res = await b.fetch(`/api/imports/${nobody}/cancel`, { method: "POST" });
    expect(await refusal(res)).toEqual([429, "rate_limited"]);
    expect(Number(res.headers.get("retry-after"))).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });

  test("this file left no import row behind", async () => {
    const { now, before } = await h.cleanup();
    expect(now).toEqual(before);
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/imports-harness.ts`

```ts
import { createHash, randomBytes, randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { mkdirSync, mkdtempSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import path from "node:path";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import pino from "pino";
import { expect } from "vitest";
import { FlowResponse, IMPORT_RULES, ImportView, MeResponse, type ImportSummary, type ImportedPost } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { closeDb, createDb, type Db } from "@korbat/db";
import { writeScanOutput } from "@korbat/import-protocol";
import { createApp } from "../../src/app";
import { createAuth } from "../../src/auth";
import { randomToken } from "../../src/auth/crypto";
import { MemoryKv } from "../../src/auth/kv";
import { loadConfig, type Config } from "../../src/config";
import { createImports, importSettingsFrom, type ImportSettings } from "../../src/imports";
import { MemoryMailer } from "../../src/mail/memory";
import { MemoryStore } from "../../src/middleware/rate-limit";
import { createProfileStore } from "../../src/profiles/store";
import { createSocial } from "../../src/social";
import { Browser } from "./http-client";
import { removeFixtures, rowCounts } from "./moderation-fixtures";

/**
 * The imports module through the real app (3b design, section 12.3): sign-up over HTTP, cookie sessions with CSRF, the
 * auth, social and imports modules wired as the server wires them, the two import volumes in a temporary folder, and
 * packages/import-protocol's writeScanOutput standing in for the importer, as fakeWorker stands in for the image worker.
 */

/** The tables a file of these tests must leave as it found them. */
export const IMPORT_TABLES = ["import_jobs", "import_picks", "import_keys"];
export const DAY_MS = 86_400_000;

export const sha256 = (bytes: Uint8Array): string => createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex");

/** An archive's bytes for the declared source X or Mastodon: a zip's local header, then filler. The importer is not run. */
export function zipArchive(size: number): Uint8Array {
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(size);
  bytes.set([0x50, 0x4b, 0x03, 0x04], 0);
  for (let i = 4; i < size; i++) bytes[i] = (i * 31) % 253;
  return bytes;
}

/** One line of posts.jsonl as the importer writes it. */
export function line(ref: number, over: Partial<ImportedPost> = {}): ImportedPost {
  const day = String((ref % 28) + 1).padStart(2, "0");
  return {
    ref,
    key: createHash("sha256").update(`line ${ref} ${over.text ?? ""}`).digest("hex"),
    at: `2019-03-${day}T12:00:00Z`,
    kind: "post",
    parent: null,
    text: `imported line ${ref}`,
    media: [],
    protected: false,
    warning: false,
    ...over,
  };
}

export function scanned(id: string, posts: number, over: Partial<Extract<ImportSummary, { status: "scanned" }>> = {}): ImportSummary {
  return { v: 1, id, status: "scanned", posts, images: 0, skipped: {}, imagesSkipped: {}, cleaned: 0, warnings: 0, sourceLinks: 0, protectedPosts: 0, readInPart: false, ...over };
}

export interface HarnessOptions {
  settings?: Partial<ImportSettings>;
  /** The importer's heartbeat written at the start; fresh unless false. */
  heartbeat?: boolean;
}

export async function importsHarness(options: HarnessOptions = {}) {
  const config: Config = loadConfig();
  const logger = pino({ level: "silent" });
  const authDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_AUTH, { max: 4 });
  const apiDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 6 });
  const migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 1 });
  const root = mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(), "korbat-imports-"));
  const mailer = new MemoryMailer();
  const rateLimitStore = new MemoryStore();
  /** The free space import-archives reports: plenty, unless a test sets less. */
  let free = 64 * 1024 ** 3;
  const auth = createAuth({
    config,
    logger,
    authDb,
    kv: new MemoryKv(),
    mailer,
    profiles: createProfileStore(apiDb),
    turnstile: { verify: async () => true },
    breachChecker: { isBreached: async () => false },
  });
  const social = createSocial({ apiDb, rateLimitStore, logger, requireSession: auth.requireSession, requireFreshAuth: auth.requireFreshAuth() });
  const settings: ImportSettings = { ...importSettingsFrom(config), ...options.settings };
  const imports = createImports({
    apiDb,
    archivesDir: path.join(root, "archives"),
    workDir: path.join(root, "work"),
    settings,
    auth: auth.forImports,
    social: social.forImports,
    rateLimitStore,
    requireSession: auth.requireSession,
    logger,
    freeBytes: async () => free,
  });
  await imports.prepare();
  mkdirSync(path.join(root, "work"), { recursive: true });
  const app = createApp({ config, logger, rateLimitStore, healthChecks: {}, auth, social, imports });
  const made: string[] = [];
  const before = await rowCounts(apiDb, IMPORT_TABLES);
  const work = imports.deps.files.work;
  const archives = imports.deps.files.archives;

  /** The importer's heartbeat, `{ v: 1, at }`, as it writes it every ten seconds. */
  const beat = (at = Date.now()) => writeFileSync(work.heartbeat, JSON.stringify({ v: 1, at }));
  if (options.heartbeat !== false) beat();

  /** A signed-in, onboarded web account whose profile is `ageDays` old (eight unless said, past the import's seven). */
  async function signUp(options: { ageDays?: number; ip?: string } = {}) {
    const b = new Browser(app, config.APP_ORIGIN, options.ip === undefined ? {} : { ip: options.ip });
    const email = `imports-${randomUUID()}@korbat.local`;
    const handle = `i${randomBytes(4).toString("hex")}`;
    const start = await b.fetch("/api/auth/email/start", { json: { email, turnstileToken: "ok", deviceId: randomToken(), platform: "web" } });
    const { flowId } = FlowResponse.parse(await start.json());
    expect((await b.fetch("/api/auth/email/verify", { json: { flowId, code: mailer.lastCodeFor(email) } })).status).toBe(200);
    expect((await b.fetch("/api/auth/signup/complete", { json: { flowId, dateOfBirth: "1990-05-17", termsVersion: config.TERMS_VERSION } })).status).toBe(200);
    expect((await b.fetch("/api/auth/onboarding/handle", { json: { handle, displayName: `User ${handle}` } })).status).toBe(200);
    const id = MeResponse.parse(await (await b.fetch("/api/me")).json()).user.id;
    made.push(id);
    await age(id, options.ageDays ?? 8);
    return { b, id, handle, email };
  }

  /** Sets the profile's age, as only the migrator may. */
  const age = (id: string, days: number) => migrateDb.execute(sql`update profiles set created_at = now() - make_interval(secs => ${days * 86_400}) where id = ${id}::uuid`);

  /** POST /api/imports. */
  const create = (b: Browser, body: unknown = { source: "mastodon", bytes: 100 }) => b.fetch("/api/imports", { json: body });

  /** Creates an import and answers its view; the request must be taken. */
  async function created(b: Browser, body: { source: "x" | "mastodon" | "bluesky"; bytes: number } = { source: "mastodon", bytes: 100 }): Promise<ImportView> {
    const res = await create(b, body);
    expect(res.status, JSON.stringify(await res.clone().json())).toBe(201);
    return ImportView.parse(await res.json());
  }

  /** One chunk, PUT /api/imports/<id>/archive, with its offset, its length and its SHA-256 unless the test says otherwise. */
  const chunk = (b: Browser, id: string, at: number, bytes: Uint8Array, headers: Record<string, string> = {}) =>
    b.fetch(`/api/imports/${id}/archive`, {
      method: "PUT",
      raw: { type: "application/octet-stream", body: bytes },
      headers: { "import-offset": String(at), "import-chunk-sha256": sha256(bytes), "content-length": String(bytes.length), ...headers },
    });

  /** The whole archive in chunks of IMPORT_RULES.chunkBytes, each taken. */
  async function upload(b: Browser, id: string, archive: Uint8Array): Promise<void> {
    for (let at = 0; at < archive.length; at += IMPORT_RULES.chunkBytes) {
      const res = await chunk(b, id, at, archive.subarray(at, Math.min(archive.length, at + IMPORT_RULES.chunkBytes)));
      expect(res.status, JSON.stringify(await res.clone().json())).toBe(200);
    }
  }

  /** An import of a new account brought to ready: created, uploaded, its scan written as the importer would, and driven. */
  async function ready(posts: readonly (ImportedPost | string)[], over: { images?: Record<string, Uint8Array>; summary?: Partial<Extract<ImportSummary, { status: "scanned" }>> } = {}) {
    const account = await signUp();
    const archive = zipArchive(100);
    const view = await created(account.b, { source: "mastodon", bytes: archive.length });
    await upload(account.b, view.id, archive);
    writeScanOutput(work.root, posts, scanned(view.id, posts.length, over.summary), over.images ?? {});
    await imports.drive(new Date(), { orphans: false });
    const shown = ImportView.parse(await (await account.b.fetch(`/api/imports/${view.id}`)).json());
    expect(shown.status).toBe("ready");
    return { ...account, view: shown };
  }

  /** The row's columns as the migrator reads them. */
  async function row(id: string) {
    const [found] = await migrateDb.execute<{ status: string; received_bytes: string; failure: string | null; scanned_at: Date | null; ended_at: Date | null; uploaded_at: Date | null; scan: unknown; images: boolean }>(
      sql`select status::text as status, received_bytes::text, failure, scanned_at, ended_at, uploaded_at, scan, images from import_jobs where id = ${id}::uuid`,
    );
    return found;
  }

  /** Removes every account the file made, with its imports, and answers the counts, which must be what they were before. */
  async function cleanup(): Promise<{ now: Record<string, number>; before: Record<string, number> }> {
    await removeFixtures(migrateDb, made.splice(0));
    return { now: await rowCounts(apiDb, IMPORT_TABLES), before };
  }

  async function close(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      await removeFixtures(migrateDb, made.splice(0));
    } finally {
      rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
      await Promise.all([closeDb(authDb), closeDb(apiDb), closeDb(migrateDb)]);
    }
  }

  const setFree = (bytes: number) => {
    free = bytes;
  };

  return { config, apiDb, migrateDb, app, imports, settings, root, work, archives, made, beat, setFree, signUp, age, create, created, chunk, upload, ready, row, cleanup, close };
}

export type ImportsHarness = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof importsHarness>>;
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/imports-picks.test.ts`

```ts
import { readFileSync, renameSync, symlinkSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { ErrorEnvelope, ImportLineView, ImportPickView, ImportView } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { importsHarness, line, type ImportsHarness } from "./imports-harness";

vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 120_000 });

/** A JPEG's, a PNG's and a GIF's first bytes, then filler: what the sniff reads. */
const JPEG = new Uint8Array([0xff, 0xd8, 0xff, 0xe0, 0, 16, 74, 70, 73, 70, 0, 1, 1, 0, 0, 1]);
const PNG = new Uint8Array([0x89, 0x50, 0x4e, 0x47, 0x0d, 0x0a, 0x1a, 0x0a, 0, 0, 0, 13, 73, 72, 68, 82]);
const GIF = new Uint8Array([71, 73, 70, 56, 57, 97, 1, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]);

/**
 * The preview's list, the picks and the preview's images (3b design, sections 4.4 and 9.2; 12.3): the lines' pages from the
 * intake's offsets with the intake's own rule, a pick saved with its line's facts and read back in the list and the
 * picks' counts, descriptions checked as AltText and only for images the source left without one, and the media route
 * for the owner alone, only while ready and bringing images, only for a file openWorkFile takes and that sniffs as an
 * image the preview shows.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the preview's lines, picks and images", () => {
  let h: ImportsHarness;
  beforeAll(async () => {
    h = await importsHarness({ settings: { maxActive: 100 } });
  });
  afterAll(async () => {
    await h?.close();
  });

  const refusal = async (res: Response) => [res.status, ErrorEnvelope.parse(await res.json()).error.code];
  const page = async (b: Awaited<ReturnType<ImportsHarness["ready"]>>["b"], id: string, n: number) => {
    const res = await b.fetch(`/api/imports/${id}/lines?page=${n}`);
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    const body = (await res.json()) as { lines: unknown[]; pages: number };
    return { lines: body.lines.map((item) => ImportLineView.parse(item)), pages: body.pages };
  };
  const pick = (b: Awaited<ReturnType<ImportsHarness["ready"]>>["b"], id: string, ref: number | string, body: unknown) => b.fetch(`/api/imports/${id}/lines/${ref}`, { method: "PUT", json: body });

  test("pages of fifty offered lines from the intake's offsets: an unreadable line is passed over, the last page is shorter, a page past the end is empty", async () => {
    const lines = Array.from({ length: 121 }, (_, ref) => (ref === 10 ? "not a line" : line(ref, ref % 7 === 1 ? { kind: "reply" } : {})));
    const { b, view } = await h.ready(lines);
    expect(view.scan?.posts).toBe(120);
    const first = await page(b, view.id, 0);
    expect(first.pages).toBe(3);
    expect(first.lines.map((item) => item.ref)).toEqual([...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, i) => i), ...Array.from({ length: 40 }, (_, i) => i + 11)]);
    expect(first.lines[1]).toEqual({ ref: 1, at: "2019-03-02", kind: "reply", marks: 1, text: "imported line 1", media: [], leftOut: false, alts: [] });
    const second = await page(b, view.id, 1);
    expect(second.lines.map((item) => item.ref)).toEqual(Array.from({ length: 50 }, (_, i) => i + 51));
    const third = await page(b, view.id, 2);
    expect(third.lines.map((item) => item.ref)).toEqual(Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, i) => i + 101));
    expect((await page(b, view.id, 3)).lines).toEqual([]);
    expect(await refusal(await b.fetch(`/api/imports/${view.id}/lines?page=-1`))).toEqual([400, "invalid_request"]);
    // Someone else's import is no import; one that left ready has no list.
    const other = await h.signUp();
    expect(await refusal(await other.b.fetch(`/api/imports/${view.id}/lines?page=0`))).toEqual([404, "not_found"]);
    expect((await b.fetch(`/api/imports/${view.id}/cancel`, { method: "POST" })).status).toBe(200);
    expect(await refusal(await b.fetch(`/api/imports/${view.id}/lines?page=0`))).toEqual([409, "wrong_state"]);
  });

  test("a pick is saved with its line's month and marks and read back in the list, the pick's answer and the import's counts; a line that is not offered is not_found", async () => {
    const lines = [line(0), line(1, { kind: "reply" }), line(2, { at: "2019-05-04T00:00:00Z", warning: true, text: "Content warning: spoilers" }), "garbage", line(4)];
    const { b, view } = await h.ready(lines);
    const res = await pick(b, view.id, 1, { leftOut: true, alts: [] });
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(ImportPickView.parse(await res.json())).toEqual({ ref: 1, leftOut: true, alts: [], picks: [{ month: "2019-03", groups: [[1, 1, 0, 0]] }] });
    expect(ImportPickView.parse(await (await pick(b, view.id, 2, { leftOut: true, alts: [] })).json()).picks).toEqual([
      { month: "2019-03", groups: [[1, 1, 0, 0]] },
      { month: "2019-05", groups: [[4, 1, 0, 0]] },
    ]);
    const listed = await page(b, view.id, 0);
    expect(listed.lines.map((item) => [item.ref, item.leftOut])).toEqual([[0, false], [1, true], [2, true], [4, false]]);
    expect(ImportView.parse(await (await b.fetch(`/api/imports/${view.id}`)).json()).picks).toEqual([
      { month: "2019-03", groups: [[1, 1, 0, 0]] },
      { month: "2019-05", groups: [[4, 1, 0, 0]] },
    ]);
    // Brought back: the line's pick stays, and counts nothing.
    expect(ImportPickView.parse(await (await pick(b, view.id, 1, { leftOut: false, alts: [] })).json()).picks).toEqual([{ month: "2019-05", groups: [[4, 1, 0, 0]] }]);
    expect(await refusal(await pick(b, view.id, 3, { leftOut: true, alts: [] }))).toEqual([404, "not_found"]);
    expect(await refusal(await pick(b, view.id, 5, { leftOut: true, alts: [] }))).toEqual([404, "not_found"]);
    expect(await refusal(await pick(b, view.id, "x", { leftOut: true, alts: [] }))).toEqual([404, "not_found"]);
    expect(await refusal(await pick(b, view.id, 0, { leftOut: "yes", alts: [] }))).toEqual([400, "invalid_request"]);
    // With images off a line takes no description.
    expect(await refusal(await pick(b, view.id, 0, { leftOut: false, alts: ["A photo"] }))).toEqual([400, "invalid_request"]);
    const other = await h.signUp();
    expect(await refusal(await pick(other.b, view.id, 0, { leftOut: true, alts: [] }))).toEqual([404, "not_found"]);
    expect((await b.fetch(`/api/imports/${view.id}/cancel`, { method: "POST" })).status).toBe(200);
    expect(await refusal(await pick(b, view.id, 0, { leftOut: true, alts: [] }))).toEqual([409, "wrong_state"]);
  });

  test("descriptions: AltText, at most four, only for an image the source left without one; the counts follow them", async () => {
    h.settings.images = true;
    let ready: Awaited<ReturnType<ImportsHarness["ready"]>>;
    try {
      ready = await h.ready([line(0, { media: [{ file: "0-0.jpg", alt: null }, { file: "0-1.png", alt: "A described chart" }, { file: "0-2.jpg", alt: null }] }), line(1)], {
        images: { "0-0.jpg": JPEG, "0-1.png": PNG },
        summary: { images: 3 },
      });
    } finally {
      h.settings.images = false;
    }
    const { b, view } = ready;
    expect((await h.row(view.id))?.images).toBe(true);
    // 0-2.jpg is missing: the intake counted it, and the line keeps two images, one described by its source.
    expect(view.scan).toMatchObject({ images: 2, imagesSkipped: { missing_file: 1 }, months: [{ month: "2019-03", groups: [[0, 2, 2, 1]] }] });
    const [listed] = (await page(b, view.id, 0)).lines;
    expect(listed!.media).toEqual([
      { file: "0-0.jpg", alt: null },
      { file: "0-1.png", alt: "A described chart" },
      { file: "0-2.jpg", alt: null },
    ]);
    const given = ImportPickView.parse(await (await pick(b, view.id, 0, { leftOut: false, alts: ["A photo of a harbour at dusk"] })).json());
    expect(given).toEqual({ ref: 0, leftOut: false, alts: ["A photo of a harbour at dusk"], picks: [{ month: "2019-03", groups: [[0, 0, 0, 1]] }] });
    expect((await page(b, view.id, 0)).lines[0]!.alts).toEqual(["A photo of a harbour at dusk"]);
    for (const alts of [[null, "Not over the source's own"], [null, null, "The missing one"], ["a", "b", "c", "d", "e"], ["   "], [String.fromCharCode(7) + "bell"], [5]]) {
      expect(await refusal(await pick(b, view.id, 0, { leftOut: false, alts })), JSON.stringify(alts)).toEqual([400, "invalid_request"]);
    }
    // Left out, the line's source-described image is counted out with it, and its given description counts no more.
    const out = ImportPickView.parse(await (await pick(b, view.id, 0, { leftOut: true, alts: ["A photo of a harbour at dusk"] })).json());
    expect(out.picks).toEqual([{ month: "2019-03", groups: [[0, 1, 1, 0]] }]);
  });

  test("the preview's images: the owner's only, while ready and bringing images, through openWorkFile, sniffed as JPEG, PNG or WebP, private and never stored", async () => {
    h.settings.images = true;
    let ready: Awaited<ReturnType<ImportsHarness["ready"]>>;
    try {
      ready = await h.ready([line(0, { media: [{ file: "0-0.jpg", alt: "One" }, { file: "0-1.jpg", alt: "Two" }, { file: "0-2.jpg", alt: "Three" }, { file: "0-3.png", alt: "Four" }] })], {
        images: { "0-0.jpg": JPEG, "0-1.jpg": PNG, "0-2.jpg": GIF, "0-3.png": new TextEncoder().encode("plain text, no image") },
      });
    } finally {
      h.settings.images = false;
    }
    const plain = await h.ready([line(0)]);
    const { b, view } = ready;
    const media = (file: string, who = b, id = view.id) => who.fetch(`/api/imports/${id}/media/${file}`);
    const jpeg = await media("0-0.jpg");
    expect(jpeg.status).toBe(200);
    expect([jpeg.headers.get("content-type"), jpeg.headers.get("cache-control"), jpeg.headers.get("x-content-type-options")]).toEqual(["image/jpeg", "private, no-store", "nosniff"]);
    expect(new Uint8Array(await jpeg.arrayBuffer())).toEqual(JPEG);
    // The bytes decide the type, never the name.
    const png = await media("0-1.jpg");
    expect([png.status, png.headers.get("content-type")]).toEqual([200, "image/png"]);
    await png.arrayBuffer();
    // A GIF, text and a name the work folder may not hold are no image of the preview.
    for (const file of ["0-2.jpg", "0-3.png", "0-0.gif", "x.jpg", "0-9.jpg"]) expect(await refusal(await media(file)), file).toEqual([404, "not_found"]);
    const other = await h.signUp();
    expect(await refusal(await media("0-0.jpg", other.b))).toEqual([404, "not_found"]);
    // An import that brings no images has none to show.
    expect(await refusal(await media("0-0.jpg", plain.b, plain.view.id))).toEqual([404, "not_found"]);
    // A media folder that is a link (a junction on Windows) to a folder holding the same file is refused.
    const elsewhere = path.join(h.root, `elsewhere-${view.id}`);
    renameSync(h.work.mediaDir(view.id), elsewhere);
    symlinkSync(elsewhere, h.work.mediaDir(view.id), "junction");
    expect(readFileSync(path.join(h.work.mediaDir(view.id), "0-0.jpg")).length).toBe(JPEG.length);
    expect(await refusal(await media("0-0.jpg"))).toEqual([404, "not_found"]);
    // Once the import has left ready, the preview's images are not shown.
    expect((await b.fetch(`/api/imports/${view.id}/cancel`, { method: "POST" })).status).toBe(200);
    expect(await refusal(await media("0-0.jpg"))).toEqual([409, "wrong_state"]);
    expect((await plain.b.fetch(`/api/imports/${plain.view.id}/cancel`, { method: "POST" })).status).toBe(200);
  });

  test("this file left no import row behind", async () => {
    const { now, before } = await h.cleanup();
    expect(now).toEqual(before);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { randomBytes, randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { existsSync, mkdirSync, renameSync, symlinkSync, utimesSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

import { writeScanOutput } from "@korbat/import-protocol";

/**

 * importer: the archive deleted once the summary is read, the intake and the move to ready, a failed scan, a summary the
 * API cannot take, the 45-minute and 24-hour bounds of a scan, the expiry of an upload and of a preview, the 72-hour
 * stop, the retention of picks and rows, and the orphans a crash leaves.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: import-drive", () => {

  beforeAll(async () => {
    // Several of this file's imports wait in scanning at once; the site's cap is http-imports.test.ts's to try.
    h = await importsHarness({ settings: { maxActive: 100 } });
  });
  afterAll(async () => {
    await h?.close();
  });

  /** A new account's import with its archive uploaded, waiting for its scan. */
  async function uploaded(options: { ageDays?: number } = {}) {
    const account = await h.signUp(options);
    const archive = zipArchive(100);
    const view = await h.created(account.b, { source: "mastodon", bytes: archive.length });
    await h.upload(account.b, view.id, archive);
    return { b: account.b, ownerId: account.id, id: view.id };
  }
  const viewOf = async (b: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof uploaded>>["b"], id: string) => ImportView.parse(await (await b.fetch(`/api/imports/${id}`)).json());
  const drive = (at = new Date()) => h.imports.drive(at, { orphans: false });

  test("a scanned summary: the archive and its marker go at once, the intake's numbers are stored, and the import is ready with its samples", async () => {
    const { b, id } = await uploaded();
    expect(existsSync(h.archives.archive(id)) && existsSync(h.archives.queued(id))).toBe(true);
    // No summary yet: the importer has not finished, and nothing moves.
    await drive();
    expect((await viewOf(b, id)).status).toBe("scanning");
    const posts = [line(0), line(1, { kind: "reply" }), line(2), line(3, { at: "2019-04-02T08:00:00Z" })];
    writeScanOutput(h.work.root, posts, scanned(id, 4, { skipped: { not_public: 9, repost: 2 }, warnings: 0 }));
    const report = await drive();
    expect(report.ready).toBe(1);
    expect(existsSync(h.archives.jobDir(id)) || existsSync(h.archives.queued(id))).toBe(false);
    const view = await viewOf(b, id);
    expect(view.status).toBe("ready");
    expect(view.scan).toMatchObject({
      posts: 4,
      skipped: { not_public: 9, repost: 2 },
      first: "2019-03",
      last: "2019-04",
      fromRef: 0,
      months: [
        { month: "2019-03", groups: [[0, 2, 0, 0], [1, 1, 0, 0]] },
        { month: "2019-04", groups: [[0, 1, 0, 0]] },
      ],
    });
    // The view carries the facts without their offsets, and the three newest lines as samples, by day.
    expect(view.scan).not.toHaveProperty("pages");
    expect(view.samples).toEqual([
      { at: "2019-04-02", text: "imported line 3" },
      { at: "2019-03-03", text: "imported line 2" },
      { at: "2019-03-02", text: "imported line 1" },

    await h.migrateDb.execute(sql`insert into posts (id, author_id, body, import_job_id, import_source, original_created_at, import_shortened, import_key)

  test("4.8: a scan not done 45 minutes after its upload, or 24 hours after its creation if that is sooner, fails as scan_timed_out", async () => {

    await drive(new Date(Date.now() + 9 * MINUTE));

    await drive(new Date(Date.now() + 11 * MINUTE));

  test("4.8: an upload not complete 24 hours after its creation expires and its part goes; a preview not confirmed 24 hours after its scan expires, its scan cut down", async () => {
    const account = await h.signUp();

    await drive(new Date(Date.now() + 23 * HOUR));
    expect((await viewOf(preview.b, preview.id)).status).toBe("ready");

    const recent = randomUUID();
    const named = randomUUID();
    for (const [id, days] of [[old, 31], [recent, 29], [named, 31]] as const) {
      await h.migrateDb.execute(sql`insert into import_jobs (id, owner_id, source, declared_bytes, status, ended_at, posts_published) values (${id}::uuid, ${ownerId}::uuid, 'x', 10, 'done', now() - make_interval(days => ${days}), 1)`);

    await h.migrateDb.execute(sql`insert into import_picks (import_job_id, ref, left_out, month, marks) values (${recent}::uuid, 0, true, '2019-03', 0)`);
    await h.migrateDb.execute(sql`insert into posts (id, author_id, body, import_job_id, import_source, original_created_at, import_shortened, import_key)
                                   values (${randomUUID()}::uuid, ${ownerId}::uuid, 'still here', ${named}::uuid, 'x', '2019-03-02T12:00:00Z', false, decode(${line(77).key}, 'hex'))`);
    const report = await drive();
    expect(report.rowsDeleted).toBe(1);
    expect(report.picksDeleted).toBe(1);
    const left = await h.migrateDb.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select id from import_jobs where owner_id = ${ownerId}::uuid order by id`);
    expect(left.map((row) => row.id).sort()).toEqual([recent, named].sort());

  test("orphans, every tenth round: an archive folder or marker of no import, or of one past its scan, goes; a work folder no import needs is asked for; a request carried out is withdrawn after an hour", async () => {
    const at = new Date();
    const old = (file: string) => utimesSync(file, new Date(at.getTime() - 2 * HOUR), new Date(at.getTime() - 2 * HOUR));
    // No row at all.
    const stray = randomUUID();
    mkdirSync(h.archives.jobDir(stray), { recursive: true });
    writeFileSync(h.archives.queued(stray), "");
    mkdirSync(h.work.jobDir(stray), { recursive: true });
    for (const file of [h.archives.jobDir(stray), h.archives.queued(stray), h.work.jobDir(stray)]) old(file);
    // A fresh stray is left for now: it may be a write in flight.
    const fresh = randomUUID();
    mkdirSync(h.archives.jobDir(fresh), { recursive: true });
    // A row that is waiting for its scan keeps its archive whatever its age.
    const waiting = await uploaded();
    old(h.archives.jobDir(waiting.id));
    old(h.archives.queued(waiting.id));
    // A request whose work folder is gone, an hour and more old.
    const done = randomUUID();
    writeFileSync(h.archives.deletion(done), "");
    old(h.archives.deletion(done));

    const report = await h.imports.drive(at, { orphans: true });
    expect(report.orphanArchives).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    expect(existsSync(h.archives.jobDir(stray)) || existsSync(h.archives.queued(stray))).toBe(false);
    expect(existsSync(h.archives.deletion(stray))).toBe(true);
    expect(existsSync(h.archives.jobDir(fresh))).toBe(true);
    expect(existsSync(h.archives.archive(waiting.id)) && existsSync(h.archives.queued(waiting.id))).toBe(true);
    expect(existsSync(h.archives.deletion(done))).toBe(false);
    // The importer carries the request out; an hour later it is withdrawn.
    old(h.archives.deletion(stray));
    await h.imports.drive(at, { orphans: true });
    expect(existsSync(h.archives.deletion(stray))).toBe(true);
    rmWork(stray);
    await h.imports.drive(at, { orphans: true });
    expect(existsSync(h.archives.deletion(stray))).toBe(false);
    // Rounds without the orphans' step touch none of it.
    mkdirSync(h.archives.jobDir(stray), { recursive: true });
    old(h.archives.jobDir(stray));
    await drive(at);
    expect(existsSync(h.archives.jobDir(stray))).toBe(true);
  });

  /** What the importer does on a deletion request. */
  function rmWork(id: string) {
    renameSync(h.work.jobDir(id), path.join(h.root, `removed-${id}`));
  }

  test("this file left no import row behind", async () => {
    const { now, before } = await h.cleanup();
    expect(now).toEqual(before);
  });
});
```
